invariants.rationale: The method returns a list generated by collecting filtered stream results, which is never null.
The output list is a filtered subset of the input list, so its size cannot exceed the input's.

invariants.expression: hoodieRecords == null || result.isEmpty() || result.get(0) instanceof HoodieRecord
invariants.rationale: If the result is non-empty, its elements are HoodieRecords, matching the input.
If input is null or empty, result will also be empty or at most have as many elements as input.
By construction, the method filters so that every record in the result does not have a known current location.
